The different textures, shapes, and colors make this a fun set for hobbyists, kids’ science projects, or decorative bowls and terrariums. If you enjoy sorting, displaying, or crafting with natural materials, this group of stones offers a lot of character and visual interest in a compact bundle. The blue polished slice has a smooth, glossy surface with light edge wear. Surfaces show minor dust and residue from handling and display.

276629653.description:
You are purchasing a "Mixed Crystal and Tumbled Stone Lot with Specimens" in "Used" condition.
Colorful mixed lot of crystals, polished tumbled stones, and rough mineral specimens—perfect for collectors, crafters, or anyone who loves the energy and beauty of natural stones. This set includes: - A variety of polished tumbled stones in multiple colors and sizes - Several rough/raw mineral chunks with interesting textures - A rose-colored crystal cluster and a light green crystal cluster - A wire-wrapped hanging piece with multiple small stones - A small fabric drawstring pouch Use these stones for crystal grids, jewelry making, wire wrapping, decor, terrariums, or as a starter collection. The mix of shapes, sizes, and colors makes it easy to create eye-catching displays or unique handmade gifts. Bring natural sparkle and earthy charm to your space or projects with this ready-to-use assortment. Keywords: crystal lot, mixed stones, tumbled stones, rough crystals, mineral specimens, crafting stones, jewelry making supplies, crystal decor, stone collection, bulk crystals measures approx. 11.5x7x5.5
Condition Notes:
Mixed lot of crystals, raw mineral specimens, and polished tumbled stones with minor surface wear and small chips typical of handled stones. Some stones show natural rough edges and texture. Drawstring pouch and hanging wire-wrapped tree ornament show light handling and creasing but no major damage.
